verdict.rationale: Exa ships an official, open-source hosted MCP server at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp. Its documentation includes a complete setup guide for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex, and other MCP clients. The server exposes web search, fetching, code search, Exa Agent (agent_run), and Exa Connect tools, and it works with OAuth, an API key, or no key to start. It is also an official plugin in OpenAI's plugin directory, and a probe confirmed the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server actually working in practice.
